'''Toadpole''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Toadpole}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Spike Spit
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (3;{{Asc2|9|4}}) damage ×3. Removes 2 {{BD2|Thorns}} from self.
|GivesToEnemy = Thorns
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Whirl
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (7;{{Asc2|9|8}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Spiken
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 2 {{BD2|Thorns}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Thorns
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Cycles through its moves in a fixed order: {{Int2|Toadpole|Whirl}}, then {{Int2|Toadpole|Spiken}}, then {{Int2|Toadpole|Spike Spit}}, repeating. In the Toadpoles (Weak) encounter, the front Toadpole starts with {{Int2|Toadpole|Spiken}} instead.

== Trivia ==
* The Toadpole appears to be the larval form of a {{M2|Spiny Toad}}, as they share very similar mechanics and near identical color palettes.
